text.tspan: SWDA Service Request Classifier – AWS + Databricks Network Architecture
Numbers = assessment sections 1–11 · no internet ingress · all AWS service access via VPC endpoints
Regional AWS services – managed multi-AZ by AWS
11 Hands-on PoC (local, this repo) – stands in for components tagged PoC
public subnet (NAT egress only, no inbound)
one Databricks workspace (logical), split across accounts
Arrows point from the caller to the callee; responses return on the same connection.
1b/5a read features, write predictions (S3 gateway endpoint)
5b predictions → caseworker app + Power BI (SQL Warehouse, PrivateLink → TGW)
→ IGW → internet: allowlisted FQDNs only, no inbound
0.0.0.0/0 from every private subnet → firewall endpoint
SCC relay to control plane (back-end PrivateLink)
DR region (only if SWDA data-residency policy allows; otherwise a separate in-region backup account)
Target: RPO ≤ 1 h (one batch window), RTO ≤ 4 h
MCP path degrades to 'service unavailable', never guesses
Common services (account / region-wide, used by every component above)
